calls.actual_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: representative game flavor RETAIL CARTON prototype, not a finished game adoption. Reference image 1: official manufacturer's 50g carton; use ONLY its believable shallow paper-carton construction, front-dominant camera and restrained retail information hierarchy. Create a new original fictional-game package, not an Al Fakher replica. Subject: ONE compact 50g folding paperboard box, front width:height roughly 3:4, shallow depth about one quarter of front width, clearly visible top fold and right side; not a tall gift box, tin or pouch. Style: crisp illustrated retail product rendering, convincing matte print and folded cardboard, subtle upper-left studio form shading, no reflected floor or outside shadow. Design: deep charcoal-black stock, a clean modest upper brand zone, one restrained flat flavor-color panel, a small accurate own-ingredient image printed in the lower third; strong empty space and clear front hierarchy. Use plain independently designed white sans-serif text "AF" ONLY at upper front; AF is the existing abbreviation of the game's fictional brand アルファーヘブン. No other text or digits. Product names stay in external HTML captions. Do not copy the reference crown, actual manufacturer name, Arabic lettering, promotional tag, exact brushstroke artwork or label trade dress. No decorative grass, background foliage, botanical wallpaper, vines, ornamental leaf borders, flowers, loose ingredients outside the box, extra fruit, hookah, HMD or people. Mint leaves permitted ONLY for mint itself. For fruit flavors, no green leaves behind fruit. Composition: square PNG, whole single carton centered at about 75% canvas height, at least 10% genuinely transparent empty margin on ALL sides, true RGBA alpha. Flavor panel: muted cool green. Ingredient printed on lower front: just one small clean cluster of three fresh mint leaves, no other herbs, no flowers or leaf pattern elsewhere. Keep AF unobscured.
